from manim import *
import numpy as np

# === TeachingScene Base Class ===
class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

# === Section 2 Scene ===
class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout
        lines = [
            "Light waves have both amplitude and phase properties.",
            "Interference happens when two light waves overlap.",
            "Aligned peaks create brightness, while opposing peaks cancel out."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite: The Language of Waves", lines)
        
        # Area for waves
        AREA_TL = "B1"
        AREA_BR = "E6"
        
        # Get dimensions for manual point calculation based on grid
        tl_pos = self.grid[AREA_TL]
        br_pos = self.grid[AREA_BR]
        center = (tl_pos + br_pos) / 2
        width = br_pos[0] - tl_pos[0]
        
        # Trackers
        phase_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        amp_tracker = ValueTracker(0.7) # Base amplitude
        
        # Helper to generate points
        def get_sine_points(phase, amplitude):
            num_points = 80
            xs = np.linspace(-width/2, width/2, num_points)
            # freq chosen to show about 2 full cycles in the width
            freq = (2 * 2 * np.pi) / width
            return [center + np.array([x, amplitude * np.sin(freq * x - phase), 0]) for x in xs]

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # A white sine wave #FFFFFF oscillates horizontally across the black background.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        
        wave1 = VMobject(color=WHITE)
        wave1.set_points_as_corners(get_sine_points(0, amp_tracker.get_value()))
        
        def wave1_updater(m):
            m.set_points_as_corners(get_sine_points(phase_tracker.get_value(), amp_tracker.get_value()))
            
        wave1.add_updater(wave1_updater)
        self.add(wave1)
        
        # Initial oscillation
        self.play(phase_tracker.animate.set_value(2 * PI), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # The peak of the wave flashes yellow #FFFF00 and the trough flashes magenta #FF00FF to show phase.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].set_color(GRAY),
            self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        )
        
        peak_dot = Dot(color=YELLOW)
        trough_dot = Dot(color=MAGENTA)
        
        def dots_updater(group):
            pts = wave1.get_points()
            if len(pts) > 0:
                y_vals = pts[:, 1]
                p_idx = np.argmax(y_vals)
                t_idx = np.argmin(y_vals)
                group[0].move_to(pts[p_idx])
                group[1].move_to(pts[t_idx])
        
        dots = VGroup(peak_dot, trough_dot)
        dots.add_updater(dots_updater)
        self.add(dots)
        
        self.play(
            Flash(peak_dot, color="#FFFF00", flash_radius=0.4),
            Flash(trough_dot, color="#FF00FF", flash_radius=0.4),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Continue oscillation to show dots following the wave
        self.play(phase_tracker.animate.set_value(4 * PI), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        
        # Remove dots before interference part
        self.remove(dots)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Two waves align their peaks, merging into a single wave with double the amplitude in cyan #00FFFF.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].set_color(GRAY),
            self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        )
        
        # Second wave - starts out of phase (shifted by PI)
        phase_tracker2 = ValueTracker(phase_tracker.get_value() + PI)
        wave2 = VMobject(color=WHITE, stroke_opacity=0.6)
        
        def wave2_updater(m):
            m.set_points_as_corners(get_sine_points(phase_tracker2.get_value(), amp_tracker.get_value()))
            
        wave2.add_updater(wave2_updater)
        self.add(wave2)
        
        self.wait(1)
        
        # 1. Align phases
        self.play(
            phase_tracker2.animate.set_value(phase_tracker.get_value()),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # 2. Merge: double amplitude and change color to Cyan
        self.play(
            amp_tracker.animate.set_value(1.4),
            wave1.animate.set_color("#00FFFF"),
            wave2.animate.set_color("#00FFFF").set_stroke(opacity=0),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.remove(wave2)
        
        # Final result oscillation of the combined wave
        final_phase = phase_tracker.get_value() + 2 * PI
        self.play(phase_tracker.animate.set_value(final_phase), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
        
        self.wait(2)
